answer_1.quote: We study the problem of perspective summarization in a multitask learning setting. We employ perspective relevance and stance classifications as two auxilliary tasks to the summarization objective.

answer_2.quote: We first evaluate the generated perspective summaries against the target perspective with ROUGE and BERTSCORE metrics.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 100 instances of abstracts with query from the test set, and ask two human raters to judge the quality of perspectives generated by the four systems.
answer_4.guideline: We shuffle their order and ask the raters to rank each summary by the overall quality, with four criteria considered (1) Fluency (2) Grammatical Correctness (3) Faithfulness to the arguments offered in the original abstract (4) Salience.
criteria: Faithfulness to the arguments offered in the original abstract
